source: English Wikipedia 'Flag of …' infoboxes and articles; British Indian Ocean Territory also from biot.gov.io
rules: adopted = the latest visible change to the design, or the year it was made official; a law that only set shades or wrote down proportions already in use does not count
readopted flags keep the readoption year
origin only for the same recognisable design, at least 5 years older, one year, no chains; each year gets a label of at most four words from the article, or none
'official' only for flags that are official today
